answer: A registry can forge each agent a one-time onyx-bound identity key inside a hardware enclave, so one device yields one credential no matter how many accounts it spawns. Creating a fake identity then costs a real enclave or a locked stake, while honest agents pass for free. Sybil farming becomes a dune of sand: every grain looks identical, but each one must be paid for separately, so flooding the economy costs more than it earns.
